title: Research: fit-level residual C5 local-opt charging fails on diagonal I (460>224; no new kappa)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Bounded follow-up under priority revision 6, card `coverage-law-change`. After termwise nonnegative C5 charging was capped at `180/7` (`research/c5-global-charging-obstruction` / `c5-global-charging-ceiling`), those packages left a coefficient-sensitive completed-fit OQ about residual/local-opt summing. This package names and falsifies that candidate only:

`∑_C Cost_opt(K|_C) ≤ Cost_opt(K)` fails on `K = I_112`.

Granting all 23 physical C5 floors of 20 gives LHS ≥ **460**; the explicit diagonal decomposition `I = ∑_i e_i e_i^T` has complete-plane tariff exactly **224** (the same diagonal cost already recorded in the charging-ceiling prior). Dual scanners agree. J-bearing identity extensions do not discriminate the candidate. Local floor theorems of 20 are **granted**, not replayed.

**Scoped method audit.** Not a new global decoder floor, not a κ claim, and not a closure of the still-open cancellation-identity OQ. Selected κ stays `0.001672660197076918`.

## Task and overlap

- Package: `research/c5-fit-level-residual-charge/`
- Tip: `8b0ed94fd5bdee05d142addfc7d9403391764d70`
- Content tip: `c8a6fa90dde7a2d0ac5dedd601d7122802fa4815`
- Base: `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90` (SOURCES geometry pin `463113d675af7410ac91d53a4fed51ec6494eb9a`)
- Scope: **changed** — residual/local-opt charging candidate after termwise `180/7`

Closest priors: `c5-global-charging-obstruction` / `c5-global-charging-ceiling` (termwise ceiling + diagonal 224; leave-alone), `c5-four-residual-floors` (local floors). Soft-overlap with obstruction verify ≈0.52 (shared geometry scaffold); scientific novelty is naming/closing the residual-local-opt inequality on the cheap diagonal fit. Preferred commoncut35 was already on main as `p112-mixed566-cut35` (not reprinted). Does not continue P104 side-correction or stock-leaf DEFERs.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -W error -B research/c5-fit-level-residual-charge/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/c5-fit-level-residual-charge/verify.py
python3.12 -I -W error -B research/c5-fit-level-residual-charge/independent.py
python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/c5-fit-level-residual-charge/test_verify.py
python3.12 -W error -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/c5-fit-level-residual-charge
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_C5_FIT_LEVEL_RESIDUAL_CHARGE cycles=23 local_floor_sum=460 diagonal_cost=224 inequality_holds=false
PASS_C5_FIT_LEVEL_RESIDUAL_CHARGE_INDEPENDENT cycles=23 local_floor_sum=460 diagonal_cost=224 inequality_holds=false
# test_verify: 9 tests OK
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/c5-fit-level-residual-charge outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()` and still fires under `-O`.

## Open next questions

1. Does an explicit cancellation identity (beyond residual local-opt costs) give a valid fit-level charge that beats the termwise `180/7` ceiling?
